item.title: U.S. orders more diplomats to leave Middle East
item.summary: The State Department’s most recent directives apply to personnel in Turkey and Saudi Arabia, underscoring the ongoing threat posed by Iranian counterattacks.

item.title: Early Iran strikes cost $5.6 billion in munitions, Pentagon estimates
item.summary: The figure, accounting for the war’s first two days, is likely to intensify concerns in Congress that U.S. forces are churning through a scarce supply of advanced weaponry.

item.title: Iran rallies around new leader after 10 days of war as oil prices spike
item.summary: President Donald Trump called surging oil costs a “very small price to pay.” Group of Seven leaders are set to convene Monday to assess the economic fallout.

item.title: Khamenei’s son chosen as Iran’s supreme leader, extending hard-line rule
item.summary: The selection of Mojtaba Khamenei sent a message of defiance against Donald Trump after U.S.-Israeli strikes killed his father Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: 7th U.S. service member killed in war with Iran; Khamenei’s son named supreme leader
item.summary: The new supreme leader was selected as environmental fallout from Israeli strikes on fuel depots blanketed parts of Tehran.

item.title: For Israel’s Netanyahu, Trump grants wishes, but his support carries risks
item.summary: Trump and Netanyahu, two political high rollers, are seen as more of an odd couple than Roosevelt-Churchill or Clinton-Blair. The war in Iran is their biggest gamble yet.

item.title: Trump said he ended a war in Africa. U.S. sanctions say otherwise.
item.summary: The administration says Rwandan-backed militants violated a Trump-brokered peace accord within days.

item.title: Trump says Iran targets will expand, honors U.S. troops killed in war
item.summary: President Donald Trump honors slain U.S. service members at Dover, threatens to widen U.S. targets after Iran’s president dismissed the notion of surrender.

item.title: Trump threat to blow up trade deal puts Canada’s auto town on the spot
item.summary: The Canadian auto industry has been rocked by President Donald Trump’s abandonment of subsidies for electric vehicles and embrace of tariffs.

item.title: The northern lights have peaked. Here’s how to see them before they fade.
item.summary: As the 11-year cycle downshifts from solar maximum to solar minimum, the lights will begin to diminish, so the time to plan a trip is now.
